newsitem.title: INDIA: India NSE trading disrupted by satellite problems.
newsitem.headline: India NSE trading disrupted by satellite problems.

text.p: India's National Stock Exchange (NSE) said on Wednesday that trading had been disrupted by satellite problems with the INSAT-IIA satellite.
"The market will open for trading after the satellite communication is restored by the DoT (Department of Telecommunications)," it said in a statement.
NSE said it expected to have fresh information on the situation by 12.30 p.m. (0700 GMT).
